verdict.rationale: The evidence documents plan upgrades and downgrades as a billing-engine capability, but nothing shows a hosted customer portal or embeddable components that let end customers upgrade, downgrade, or cancel on their own. That makes the plan-change docs an adjacent building block, not self-service delivery of this story.

support.subject: As a founder, my customers can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel themselves through a hosted portal or embeddable components, without a support ticket
